contract: Frozen KF00-KF25 visual checkpoints over the existing 13-stage scene controller; no parallel 26-stage state machine.

checkpoints.Visual State: Home identifies the photo-capture intent
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Home CTA semantics and visible UI state
checkpoints.Completion Condition: CTA is interactable and navigation enters Identify
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Gallery or first-capture guide route

checkpoints.Visual State: Camera Runtime and capture preview
checkpoints.Runtime Stage: Identify / Camera UI; outside recognition animation
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Camera preview frame and capture output
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Captured or selected PhotoSession is accepted and routed to Recognizing
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Gallery selection when camera is unavailable

checkpoints.Visual State: Real photo stable first frame
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Photo host first presented frame callback
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Controller accepts first stable photo frame and anchors the single scene clock
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Photo-load error screen with retry

checkpoints.Visual State: AI Orb wake and breath
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Orb first-frame presentation; GPU receipt when GL owns rendering
checkpoints.Completion Condition: ORB_WAKE stage duration and required rendering/event gates are satisfied
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Compose Orb remains visible when GL is rejected

checkpoints.Visual State: Resident activation inside the Orb; five Resident paths remain part of the Orb lifecycle
checkpoints.Runtime Stage: ORB_RELEASE; internal Resident activation state, not a fourteenth Stage
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Resident wake-in envelope on the shared scene clock
checkpoints.Consumer: OrbFilamentRenderer Resident paths and OrbCrystal renderer
checkpoints.Required Event: STAGE_ENTER(ORB_RELEASE) with Resident lifecycle sampled as ACTIVE
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Resident filament draw result / five-path topology evidence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Five Resident paths become ACTIVE without Task count or Task Energy affecting them
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Existing single-owner Compose Orb renderer

checkpoints.Visual State: Orb releases Task energy
checkpoints.Photo Identity: One measured Photo Transform shared with ARRIVAL and FISH_PATH
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Trusted Mask identity when path binds
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted EnergyEvent + actual stage draw evidence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: RELEASE endpoint equals the corresponding ARRIVAL start
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for Orb anchor or measured photo transform

checkpoints.Visual State: First Task energy contact on the photo
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Same Photo Transform as RELEASE and FISH_PATH
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Mask identity preserved when P* is bound
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted ARRIVAL EnergyEvent with measured contact coordinate
checkpoints.Completion Condition: ARRIVAL start is continuous with RELEASE end; first contact lies on measured photo perimeter
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: WAITING_FOR_PHOTO_GEOMETRY

checkpoints.Visual State: Perimeter coverage
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Monotonic traversal of measured perimeter path
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Trusted identity required only for fish binding
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Rendered perimeter branch receipt / accepted PathLedger event
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Branch remains on actual photo perimeter with continuous direction and endpoints
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: WAITING_FOR_PHOTO_GEOMETRY

checkpoints.Visual State: Task energy split and fish search starts
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Task paths follow measured split; path count is data-driven
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Same Photo Transform as RELEASE and ARRIVAL
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Exact trusted Mask SHA + version + attempt
checkpoints.Path ID: Task Path IDs are dynamic; not Resident IDs
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted registered Task path event
checkpoints.Completion Condition: FISH_PATH begins at the actual Task branch and enters the trusted Mask
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: WAITING_FOR_MASK_BINDING or WAITING_FOR_PATH_REGISTRATION

checkpoints.Visual State: Fish search resolves real P*
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Path reaches trusted nearest Mask contact point
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted snapshot identity plus real Path bind receipt
checkpoints.Completion Condition: pStar != null and fishPath.isValid() for the current Attempt
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: WAITING_FOR_MASK_BINDING, WAITING_FOR_PATH_REGISTRATION, or terminal unavailable only at true deadline

checkpoints.Visual State: Contour A draws first continuous outline third
checkpoints.Producer: RecognitionFishFocus actual trusted Mask contour draw
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionContourRenderReceipt A
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Actual contour stroke drawn to 1/3 target and receipt accepted
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait or explicit terminal geometry failure

checkpoints.Visual State: Contour B draws second continuous outline third
checkpoints.Producer: RecognitionFishFocus actual trusted Mask contour draw
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionContourRenderReceipt B
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Actual contour stroke drawn to 2/3 target after A and receipt accepted
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait or explicit terminal geometry failure

checkpoints.Visual State: Contour C closes the real Mask outline
checkpoints.Producer: RecognitionFishFocus actual trusted Mask contour draw
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Trusted Mask SHA + version and closed contour
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionContourRenderReceipt C
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Actual closed contour drawn in order and receipt accepted
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait or explicit terminal geometry failure

checkpoints.Visual State: Gold peak over real Mask contour
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionFishGoldRenderReceipt with core, glow, halo and glint draws
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Final Gold frame actually drawn and matching receipt accepted before ORB_RETURN
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for true render completion or terminal Mask geometry failure

checkpoints.Visual State: Three-segment energy return from real P* to Orb
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Processing Photo identity projected into Result root
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Same Mask SHA and version from FishPathSnapshot
checkpoints.Geometry Version: Same Path geometry identity; coordinate projection only
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Actual draw along all three projected original RETURN segments
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Path ID, P*, Mask, geometry and all segment endpoints remain unchanged across projection
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Independent ORB_ONLY path only for legal Orb-only decision
checkpoints.Test Evidence: RecognitionRevealReturnPathProjector preserves all three source segments, path ID, P-star and Mask identity under measured translation

checkpoints.Visual State: Task energy merges while five Resident strands remain active
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Shared scene clock; Task merge does not dissolve Orb
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Bound Task Mask identity retained in event trace
checkpoints.Path ID: Merged Task path IDs; G01/G02/A01/A02/C01 stay Resident
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted Task RETURN event and Resident ACTIVE evidence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Task merge is recorded independently; Orb Core and five Residents remain active
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for RETURN event identity match

checkpoints.Visual State: Orb Core stretches horizontally
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Same Attempt identity, Mask retained until path handoff
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionOrbCoreDissolveReceipt progress and nonzero measured draw sequence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Stretch actually rendered without removing Core before Gold Peak
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for the accepted Task merge and renderer receipt

checkpoints.Visual State: Orb Core dissolves into name formation
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Dissolve after stretch; Task merge is not dissolution
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionOrbCoreDissolveReceipt with monotonic draw sequence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: GLYPH_PATH_READY only after actual Core dissolve receipt
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for draw receipt; no fixed sequence constant
checkpoints.Test Evidence: RecognitionResultRuntimeTest dissolve identity and sequence contract

checkpoints.Visual State: Classifier name Glyph paths are ready
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Path construction readiness; glyph not yet claimed stable
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionGlyphPathDescriptor identity and expected character/contour count
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Real classifier species name and matching Glyph Path are ready
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Show interactive recognition error/low result when Glyph cannot be built

checkpoints.Visual State: 12.2 GLYPH_EMERGENCE internal state then Glyph becomes NAME_STABLE
checkpoints.Runtime Stage: SPECIES_NAME_REVEAL internal Stage12 state; not an added frame or Stage
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: Actual Glyph path draw progress before full completion
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionGlyphDrawReceipt with monotonic draw sequence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Classifier-matched Chinese name is actually drawn; NAME_STABLE accepted only at Stage12 boundary
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Interactive error/low result if no valid Glyph path

checkpoints.Visual State: Name is stable at the Stage12 completion boundary; Stage13 begins photo settling
checkpoints.Runtime Stage: SPECIES_NAME_REVEAL / Stage12 completion boundary; NAME_STABLE accepted once, never duplicated in Stage13
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Same Processing and Result Photo identity
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Original reveal Mask identity if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Path ID: Original Return Path ID if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Accepted same-identity Glyph draw receipt
checkpoints.Completion Condition: 13.1 accepted at Stage12 boundary; not retriggered after Stage13
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Static/error Result UI when no animated reveal is eligible

checkpoints.Visual State: Photo settles into Result Hero
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Exact processing Photo identity equals Result Photo identity
checkpoints.Geometry Version: Measured Processing Viewport to Result Root projection
checkpoints.Path ID: Same original Path ID if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Photo Hero transform-at-target and render-ready snapshot
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Photo transform target reached; shared photo remains visible until Hero takes over
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for layout geometry; permanent invalid geometry shows interactive error Result
checkpoints.Test Evidence: Result Hero geometry and handoff tests

checkpoints.Visual State: Result scene content handoff accepted
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Same Processing and Result Photo identity
checkpoints.Path ID: Same Return Path ID if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Actual Result geometry and hero/photo readiness state
checkpoints.Completion Condition: Result scene receives the same identity, geometry and path snapshot atomically
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Wait for pending geometry; permanent invalid geometry produces interactive fallback UI
checkpoints.Test Evidence: RecognitionResultRuntimeTest ordered handoff and transaction tests

checkpoints.Visual State: Result information enters and finishes drawing
checkpoints.Path ID: Same original Return Path ID if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionResultInfoRenderReceipt from actual content draw and monotonic pass sequence
checkpoints.Completion Condition: 13.4 accepted after entrance render receipt; layout readiness alone is insufficient
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Continue waiting while valid entrance is in progress; explicit layout failure remains interactive

checkpoints.Visual State: Result scene stable after all prerequisites
checkpoints.Path ID: Same original Return Path ID if FULL_REVEAL
checkpoints.Render Receipt: RecognitionResultStableRenderReceipt after actual root draw and prerequisite validation
checkpoints.Completion Condition: All five Handoff events accepted and Result page stable; only then flow COMPLETE
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Remain interactive with explicit error when geometry is terminally invalid

checkpoints.Visual State: Result Save entry is interactive
checkpoints.Runtime Stage: Result UI interaction; after 13.5 stable scene
checkpoints.Stage Local Progress: UI interaction, not a recognition animation stage
checkpoints.Photo Identity: Saved Catch record retains same PhotoSession identity
checkpoints.Mask Identity: Same Mask identity attached to fish details when available
checkpoints.Path ID: Original reveal Path ID stored with Attempt evidence
checkpoints.Render Receipt: Save callback result and persisted record receipt; button highlight is not success
checkpoints.Completion Condition: User tap starts save and repository returns saved record identity or explicit failure
checkpoints.Fallback Branch: Login required or inline save error; Result remains interactive
checkpoints.Test Evidence: RecognitionResultScreen save flow and repository tests
